Today’s Report

Open Today – Happy Thanksgiving! 

The Deer Point Express, Morning Star Express, Coach Chairlift, Easy Rider Conveyor, and Discovery Conveyor spin from 9 am to 4 pm today 🍽️

Mostly cloudy skies are in the forecast today, with a high of 39º 🥧 Expect variable winds, ranging from 7 mph to 11 mph 🌬️ If you’re riding with us today, be sure to wear warm layers, a windbreaker, and low-light goggle lenses (orange/yellow) 🌥️

Spend your holiday weekend at #YourLocalPlayground! The Frontier Point Nordic lodge and trails are open from 9 am to 4 pm open through Sunday. The tube hill opens tomorrow, Friday, for the weekend 👏

Early Season Conditions Exist! Ride with caution when riding on un-groomed terrain. For the best experience, we recommend sticking to groomed terrain 🤩

SKIP THE LINE! Tickets are available to purchase online in advance Twilight Season Pass holders have mountain access from 3 pm to close. Upgrade to a Value Season Pass and ride all day!

All uphill traffic is prohibited. 

⚠️ Snowmaking in Progress ⚠️ Please keep away from snowmaking infrastructure.
